# pve_vm_shutdown (Action)

Shut a VM down gracefully.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_vm_shutdown" "example" {
  config {
    node = "pve1"
    vmid = 100
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_vm_shutdown.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) ID of the VM.

### Optional

- `forcestop` (Boolean) Make sure the VM stops. (default: 0)
- `keepactive` (Boolean) Do not deactivate storage volumes. (default: 0)
- `skiplock` (Boolean) Ignore locks - only root is allowed to use this option.
- `timeout` (Number) Wait maximal timeout seconds.
